micro_fnb_ops_consultant.note: micro food businesses pay less per day than corporates but engagements are short and repeatable; often packaged fixed-price

demand_signals: SME digitalization push continues; process-audit demand from 5-50 employee firms
PMET retrenchment cohort itself is a growing market for career/ops services
Corporate training demand steady; SkillsFuture funding channels favor certified trainers

Home-based F&B boom persists post-2020: large base of home-based sellers and hawker-adjacent micro brands; common pain points are costing/margin, production consistency at volume, and the step-up from home kitchen to SFA-licensed premises — almost no structured ops help marketed to this segment

saturation_notes.ops_process_audit_for_smes: moderately open — few solo specialists market this directly
saturation_notes.sop_documentation: open niche, low glamour, sticky retainers
saturation_notes.ops_consulting_for_micro_fnb: wide open — F&B business coaches exist for cafes/restaurants, but nobody markets production-systems and costing help to home-based and micro food businesses

utilization_assumptions.ramp_note: months 1-3 typically near-zero revenue; first client via warm network in 60-90% of solo launches
